After Effects · Lottie · Motion

Video and Animation

Motion, app-store previews and animated product moments created to explain, market and energize live-shopping products.

Project typeMotion Design
ContributionMotion + Creative Direction

01

Motion as Product Design

I used After Effects, Audition, Bodymovin and Lottie to build lightweight motion that could move from marketing into the product experience.

02

App Store Preview

The preview had to demonstrate a live-shopping format without relying on a long voiceover, balancing real footage with feature explanation and product UI.

03

Surprise & Delight

Animated characters and celebratory moments made wins, referrals and transitions feel more rewarding while keeping implementation lightweight for iOS and Android.
